tableCaption: Your plays, newest first unless sorted otherwise
showing: {first}–{last} of {total, plural, one {# play} other {# plays}}
emptyBody: Import your Extended Streaming History to see every play here.
noMatchBody: Try a wider date range or clear the search.

import.title: Import Extended Streaming History
import.howTo: Request it in Spotify → Account → Privacy settings. You’ll get a ZIP with <file>Streaming_History_Audio_*.json</file> files.
import.dropTitle: Drop JSON files here or choose files
import.dropHint: Several files at once are fine. Re-importing the same file never creates duplicates.
import.demoHint: Try it with our sample export. It is imported into your demo session only.
import.fileDone: Done · {count, plural, one {# play added} other {# plays added}}
import.keepOpen: Files are imported one at a time. Keep this page open until it finishes.
import.someFailed: {count, plural, one {One file} other {# files}} couldn’t be imported: {names}
import.notes: Podcast episodes and local files have no track ID and were skipped. Short plays count as skips (change the threshold in Settings).

zip.title: {name} isn’t a JSON export
zip.body: Unzip it first and upload the <file>Streaming_History_Audio_*.json</file> files inside.

notJson.title: {name} isn’t a JSON file
notJson.body: Upload the <file>Streaming_History_Audio_*.json</file> files from your Spotify export.

notHistory.title: {name} isn’t an Extended Streaming History file
notHistory.body: Files from the basic “Account data” export don’t contain enough detail. Request the Extended Streaming History and upload its <file>Streaming_History_Audio_*.json</file> files.

tooLarge.title: {name} is too large
tooLarge.body: Each file can be up to 30 MB. Spotify’s <file>Streaming_History_Audio_*.json</file> files are usually much smaller.

empty.title: {name} is empty
empty.body: Choose one of the <file>Streaming_History_Audio_*.json</file> files from your export.

tooMany.title: Too many files at once
tooMany.body: Import up to 20 <file>Streaming_History_Audio_*.json</file> files at a time.

failed.title: {name} couldn’t be imported
failed.body: Something went wrong on our side. Your data is safe; try the <file>file</file> again.
